action: General advice: operators of solar, storage and thermal plants should confirm that remote access paths and telecontrol are monitored and that their incident-reporting steps are rehearsed.
date_note: Date of the reporting; the Coordinador recorded the forced disconnection on 27 August 2026 and the plant was still offline in its 14 November report.
exec: A 103 MW solar plant and its battery system have been offline for almost three months after a recorded cyberattack, with no cause or restart date public.
plain: A large solar plant and battery system in northern Chile have been disconnected from the power grid since late August after a cyberattack. Almost three months on, the cause and restart date are not public.

evidence.quote: both the solar plant and the BESS had 0% availability and remained listed as forced disconnections
The 103 MW Huatacondo solar plant and its 98 MW/312 MWh battery energy storage system (BESS)

summary: Chile's Coordinador Eléctrico Nacional recorded the forced disconnection of the 103 MW Huatacondo solar plant and its 98 MW/312 MWh battery system on 27 August with the cause 'cyberattack'; its 14 November report still showed both at 0% availability. The Coordinador says an investigation remains ongoing. Tarapacá's regional energy secretary told La Estrella de Iquique, relayed by Emol, the plant stays disconnected for the owner's reasons. No technical cause or reconnection date is public.
title: Chile's Huatacondo solar plant still offline almost three months after cyberattack

validation.note: pv magazine Latinoamérica (16 Nov), pv magazine global (17 Nov), Actualidad Jurídica DOE (18 Nov) and Emol (18 Nov) read; all rely on the Coordinador's records and statements, and Emol relays the regional energy secretary via La Estrella de Iquique. The Coordinador's own report was not read. No technical details or attribution are public.

review.note: Compared with pv magazine LatAm and Actualidad Juridica: 103 MW, 98 MW/312 MWh, 27 Aug disconnection, cause cyberattack, 0% on 14 Nov, 11 Nov deputy request, no restart date
